episode_summary: In this episode, Joel Schaub discusses strategies for navigating the current real estate market, including leveraging rate buy downs and client appreciation events. He emphasizes the importance of educating clients on market conditions and building strong partnerships with lenders to enhance business growth. The episode offers actionable insights for agents looking to maintain or increase their production levels despite challenging market conditions.
